name: Genus plc
research_rationale: FY26 filings confirm adjusted PBT/FCF and dividend cover, supporting the buy, but statutory P/E and filing vs company-adjusted FCF gaps still limit how cleanly research aligns with the screen.

weekly_updates.summary:
Annual Report 2026 and AGM materials were published on 9 October; figures match September FY26 prelims, with no new trading disclosure.
The £60m buyback continues, with routine share admissions for incentive plans (including 14 October).
News flow is largely commentary on results and outlook; FY27 adjusted PBT is still guided in line with consensus.
